editorialMandate: One concise continuous history of salvation. Independent narratives are not a second extended biblical experience. Preserve canonical Scripture sources, one owner per event, and reuse existing character/event/Scripture destinations only if verified.

A.name: Essential
A.description: Decisive event or hinge in the covenant/genealogy/fulfilment/Church spine. Does not imply a full standalone chapter; can merge.

B.name: Condensed context
B.description: Mention only what makes the next main event intelligible, or preserve genealogy as separate navigation.

C.name: Independent story
C.description: Useful but not indispensable to the main story. Link from existing character, canonical event, or Scripture location only where record is verified.

D.name: No curated presentation
D.description: Do not duplicate/incorporate in compulsory narrative. Canonical Bible text remains accessible as Scripture; no content deletion.

editorialFilters: Foundational person/lineage necessary to understand the story
Creation, Fall and Redemption causal continuity
Constitution and universal mission of the Church
Do not treat source frequency as narrative necessity
Do not linearize independent exilic stories or apocalyptic visions
nonNegotiable: Do not create new person/story/event pages just to relocate filler
Never delete or rewrite canonical source passages
Keep Matthew and Luke genealogies independent and available in genealogy navigation
Preserve original 151 Atlas event identities, v18 workbook and original verse candidates
Do not mistake an omitted curated story for unimportant or noncanonical Scripture
All proposed routes require record existence verification before implementation

notableDecisions.why: Illustrates Paul's witness but does not advance the indispensable mission chronology.
